#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in quarterly_report.docx.

A .docx is a ZIP archive. We open it, read word/document.xml, find
paragraphs that are headings (pStyle values Heading1..Heading9, Title,
Subtitle, or the localized '标题' variants), and add an underline run
property (w:u w:val="single") to every run inside those paragraphs.
The modified XML is written back and the ZIP is saved in place.
"""
import zipfile
import shutil
import re
import os

SRC = 'quarterly_report.docx'
TMP = 'quarterly_report_tmp.docx'

# Paragraph style ids that mark a headline in Word (en + zh variants).
HEADING_STYLE_RE = re.compile(
    r'^(Heading\s*\d+|Title|Subtitle|标题\s*\d*|标题\s*[一二三四五六七八九十]?)$',
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r') as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    docxml = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')

changed = 0

def add_underline(match):
    global changed
    p_attrs = match.group(1)  # attributes of <w:p ...>
    body = match.group(2)     # inner XML of the paragraph
    # Determine the style id from the paragraph's pPr/pStyle
    sm = re.search(r'<w:pPr>.*?<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', body, re.DOTALL)
    if not sm or not HEADING_STYLE_RE.match(sm.group(1)):
        return match.group(0)
    # Add underline run property to every run that does not already have rPr/u
    def fix_run(run):
        r_body = run.group(2)
        has_underline = re.search(r'<w:u\s', r_body)
        if has_underline:
            return run.group(0)
        # Find an existing <w:rPr> ... </w:rPr> to insert into; else create one.
        rpr = re.search(r'<w:rPr>(.*?)</w:rPr>', r_body, re.DOTALL)
        if rpr:
            new_body = (r_body[:rpr.start()] +
                        '<w:rPr>' + rpr.group(1) + '<w:u w:val="single"/>' +
                        r_body[rpr.end():])
        else:
            new_body = r_body.replace('<w:t', '<w:rPr><w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr><w:t', 1)
            if new_body == r_body:
                new_body = '<w:rPr><w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr>' + r_body
        changed += 1
        return run.group(1) + new_body + run.group(3)

    new_body = re.sub(
        r'(<w:r\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:r>)',
        fix_run,
        body,
        flags=re.DOTALL,
    )
    return '<w:p' + p_attrs + '>' + new_body + '</w:p>'

# Match <w:p ...> ... </w:p> paragraphs (not w:pPr alone).
docxml = re.sub(
    r'<w:p(\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:p>',
    add_underline,
    docxml,
    flags=re.DOTALL,
)

# Write a fresh ZIP (copy all entries, replacing document.xml).
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r') as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'word/document.xml':
            data = docxml.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('headline paragraphs updated:', changed)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Dump paragraph styles and text from quarterly_report.docx."""
import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx', 'r') as z:
    xml = z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')

print('LENGTH:', len(xml))
# Show an indented/pretty view of paragraph starts with their pStyle and first text
import re
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', xml, re.DOTALL)
print('PARA COUNT:', len(paras))
for i, p in enumerate(paras[:80]):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
    txt = ''.join(texts)
    print(i, '| style=', style.group(1) if style else None, '| text=', txt[:80])
